basic_info.description: Fabulous investment opportunity in great Sunnyside neighborhood near City College, shopping and transportation. Each unit is one bedroom with one bathroom.  Original kitchens and baths are in clean move-in condition and offer an eat-in area and access to the exterior path to the backyard. Large picture windows in each of the unit's living rooms and bedrooms bring in bright natural light throughout. The low maintenance terraced backyard provides a nice outdoor space for tenants. Parking is available in the enclosed garage for up to 3 cars and includes additional storage space which is a definite draw in the city. Tenants will love the convenience to Safeway, Whole Foods, laundromat, restaurants and eateries just on Monterey Boulevard and in nearby Glen Park, Ocean Avenue and West Portal. The location is ideal for public transport users and commuters as the bus, Trolley, BART and access to 101 and 280 are minutes away.
